run_optical_flow_generation: run the RAFT model to generate forward and backward optical flow for a sequence of images
compute_fwdbwd_mask: compute forward and backward consistency masks from optical flow fields using the warp consistency check
warp_flow: warp an image using a given optical flow field with cubic interpolation via OpenCV remap
load_image: load an image file and convert it to a normalized PyTorch tensor on the GPU device
create_dir: create a directory if it does not already exist using os.makedirs
